pitfalls: Do NOT load subcaption (clashes with IEEEtran caption format); use \usepackage[caption=false,font=footnotesize]{subfig} instead.
Do NOT load geometry or alter two-column margins.
Table captions MUST go ABOVE tabular; figure captions go BELOW graphic.
Use \cite{a,b} with \usepackage{cite} (or natbib with [numbers,sort&compress]), never biblatex unless explicitly requested.
Keep \IEEEpeerreviewmaketitle when using peerreview options.
acmart already loads booktabs, hyperref, xcolor, amsmath, natbib (or biblatex if bibstyle option used) — avoid duplicate loading with conflicting options.
In acmart, \begin{abstract} and \keywords MUST appear BEFORE \maketitle.
Accessibility: figures benefit from \Description{...} inside figure environments.
All front-matter metadata (title, author, affiliation, abstract, keyword) must sit inside \begin{frontmatter}...\end{frontmatter}.
elsarticle loads natbib automatically; pass options via \documentclass[numbers,sort&compress]{elsarticle} rather than reloading natbib.
\keywords{...} goes INSIDE the abstract environment in llncs.
Use splncs04.bst and \usepackage{cite}; avoid loading amsthm because llncs defines proof/theorem environments.
sn-jnl uses \abstract{...} and \keywords{...} BEFORE \maketitle (command syntax, not environment).
Keep \usepackage{manyfoot} / class-bundled packages intact; check sn-*.bst path.
Check [preprint] vs [final] vs anonymized submission option on neurips style.
NeurIPS checklist section may be required in full papers.
icml uses \twocolumn[...] wrapper around \icmltitle and authorlist.
icml style requires natbib and sets hyperref options; do not reload hyperref with conflicting options.
Always compile with xelatex (or lualatex), NEVER pdflatex.
On Linux containers without Windows fonts (SimSun/SimHei), set fontset=fandol or explicitly check fc-list :lang=zh and configure fontset=none with installed Noto/Fandol fonts.
Avoid loading inputenc/fontenc alongside ctex.
Use xelatex; verify CJK font availability via fc-list.
Long theses with \include files: keep chapter files encoding UTF-8 without BOM and compile from root main.tex.
In revtex4-2, \begin{abstract} precedes \maketitle.
Do NOT load caption/subcaption packages; revtex4-2 is incompatible with caption package and warns/breaks table alignment.
Verbatim/listings inside beamer frames REQUIRE [fragile] option on \begin{frame}[fragile].
Beamer loads hyperref, xcolor, amsmath automatically; do not reload with conflicting options.
Switch to xelatex + xeCJK/ctex whenever source text contains CJK characters.
Load geometry, booktabs, amsmath, graphicx explicitly before hyperref.
